description: Template for 'Attention Is All You Need' (download the PDF from arXiv:1706.03762 yourself). Replace the questions with ones for the paper you evaluate, or draft them with `python -m evals.generate_dataset`. Keep expected_facts short, exact and distinctive (numbers with units, dataset or method names): a retrieved chunk counts as relevant when it contains one of them. Mark questions the paper cannot answer with "answerable": false.
